integrity.checker_role: finite derivative/periodic-average diagnostics, not an infinite proof

scientific_limitations: Only one-step real inverse fibers on a bounded initial-current window; no forward attractor, entropy, or cryptographic security claim.
All asymptotic errors hold for each fixed strictly positive memory coupling and fixed target; no uniform small-coupling assertion.
The printed Model 6 equation, with an additive exponential term not multiplied by the current, is interpreted literally.
The quadratic-memristor-only baseline was previously studied and is not presented as an independent new result.
Literature comparison is provisional; unindexed mathematically equivalent counts may exist.
title: A second-order inverse-sheet signature across eight sine-memristor maps
